# PocketCam

> Free Windows 11 app that turns an iPhone or Android phone browser into a webcam over the same Wi-Fi. Scan a QR in Safari or Chrome, allow the camera, and apps such as OBS, Discord, Zoom, Teams and Windows Camera see a camera named PocketCam. Nothing to install on the phone, no accounts, no cloud.

## Links

- [Download PocketCamSetup.exe](https://github.com/Mapagmataas1331/PocketCam/releases/latest/download/PocketCamSetup.exe): latest Windows 11 installer
- [Releases](https://github.com/Mapagmataas1331/PocketCam/releases): versions and release notes
- [Source on GitHub](https://github.com/Mapagmataas1331/PocketCam): readable source; not open-source licensed, see LICENSE
- [Project page](https://projects.ma.cyou/p/pocketcam): screenshots and technical notes

## Requirements

- A Windows 11 PC
- iPhone with Safari, or Android with Chrome
- Phone and PC on the same Wi-Fi, or the PC on the phone's hotspot

Not in v1: USB, a virtual microphone, Windows 10, or several phones at once.
